newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras, Brasmotor still holds.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras, Brasmotor still holds.

text.p: ING Barings said it was maintaining its hold recommendation on Brazilian white goods and appliance firm Multibras and Brasmotor but sees short-term trading opportunities in the stocks.

-- "While we are maintaining our hold recommendation on both stocks, we see a short-term trading opportunity and recommend selling Multibras and buying Brasmotor," ING analyst Thomas Atkinson said in a report.
-- "More specifically, we recommend holders of Multibras to sell at 1.17 reais or more and buy Brasmotor at 235 reais or less," he added.
-- Atkinson cited the stocks' performance over the last 12 months and showed a graph charting closing prices of Multibras and Brasmotor with bands identifying trading opportunities over the period.

-- "The upper and lower bands signal trading opportunities that, if executed at closing prices, would have generated relative gains of 11 percent, 19 percent and 23 percent all within the last 12 months," he said.
-- Brasmotor owns a 50.01 percent of Multibras, an investment that equals three-fourths of Brasmotor's shareholder equity.
-- Brasmotor preferred was off 0.42 percent at 235 reais at 1231 local/1131 edt in Sao Paulo while Multibras preferred was untraded after closing Tuesday at 1.13 reais.
